messages:
maya: Quick WFH PSA — decided to move my desk to the window for light. Router is now behind the plant and Wi-Fi dropped to 2 bars. :seedling: pic: https://i.example/plant-window-desk.jpg
lee: haha classic. Try moving the router a bit higher, plants are stealth RF absorbers. :laughing: 
violet: Alternatively, run a cheap mesh node or powerline. I keep one mesh node near the window for Zoom-heavy mornings.
maya: I have a powerline adapter but weirdly gets flaky with the dishwasher on. Any tips?
ton y: Dishwashers + power electronics = noise. Set powerline adapters to a different PLC channel if possible, or put them on a dedicated outlet (avoid surge protectors).
lee: Also check if the powerline has encryption toggle; enabling it can help stability.
violet: If you want short-term: hotspot from phone when the dishwasher is on, then raise an incident if work calls overlap.
maya: Good call. For now I'm switching to phone hotspot for the 30min call. Will try raising the node tomorrow. Also need to tidy the cable mess: before pic attached. pic: https://i.example/cable-before.jpg
ton y: Post the after — I love a good cable makeover. :sparkles:
lee: If you want, I can send my zip-tie + label hack. Saved my life during a router swap. :thumbsup:
